mapper.select: SELECT id, seller_id , name_ko, name_en, name_ja, name_zh , category , description_ko, description_en , price_krw, original_price_krw, discount , stock, weight_gram, customs_hs_code , ingredients_ko, ingredients_en , thumbnail_url, alcohol, volume, status , brewery_ko, brewery_en, brewery_ja, brewery_zh , region_ko, region_en , heritage_ko, heritage_en , tasting_ko, tasting_en, tasting_ja, tasting_zh , pairing, pairing_en, bridge_en , created_at FROM products WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT id, seller_id , name_ko, name_en, name_ja, name_zh , category , price_krw, original_price_krw, discount , stock, alcohol, volume , thumbnail_url, status , brewery_ko, brewery_en , region_ko, region_en , heritage_ko, heritage_en , created_at FROM products WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC
